topics.title: Howard Battles PLJ Station Obsession
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard Stern discusses his frustrating encounter with John Bon Jovi’s favorite radio station, PLJ, revealing repeated disbelief about its popularity and long-standing presence. He expresses annoyance at those who feign ignorance of the station's existence and recounts personal anecdotes involving listeners.

topics.title: Dice Clay, Bon Jovi & Industry Mishaps
topics.summary: During an extended radio segment, hosts discuss various mishaps involving comedian Dice Clay, including his changing hair style, being burned by Bon Jovi for not showing up to a tour appearance and Sam’s role in the situation. They express frustration with Sam's behavior and offer commentary on industry dynamics.

topics.title: Sam, Leslie & The Wild Thing
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Sam’s relationship with Leslie becomes complicated after he takes ‘the wild thing’ from her without paying. He then inappropriately uses Jessica before holding a bizarre press conference about his friend Tom Chiusano's financial troubles and making disparaging remarks.

topics.title: Backstage Chaos & Sam’s Schemes
topics.summary: During a press conference, Howard discusses a young fan's tearful reaction to Bon Jovi and an apparent scheme involving a 15-year-old girl named Sarah and caller Sam. Subsequent callers reveal Sam has been pursuing multiple girls, accusing bon jovi of scamming him.

topics.title: Sam Kinison Controversy & Bon Jovi Dislike
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts express outrage over Sam Kinison’s actions and disparaging remarks about Bon Jovi, fueled by listener calls expressing support for Kinison or condemnation of his behavior. A bizarre discussion involving Beijing's drinking age and stomach anxieties briefly shifts to the Beach Boys discussing harmony before returning to the ongoing controversy.

topics.title: Hosts Frustrated with Sam Kennison
topics.summary: During a radio discussion, hosts express growing frustration with comedian Sam Kennison after his failure to appear for a scheduled show and subsequent attempts to involve Bon Jovi. They dismiss his actions as delusional, highlighting his lack of understanding regarding ticket sales and disrespecting the program’s efforts, ultimately deeming him detrimental.
